meaning: Destiny — that each person is given their own, and no two are alike
note: From “Esono onipa biara ne ne nkrabea”, everybody has their own destiny, and “Onyame nkrabea mu nni kwatibea”, God’s destiny cannot be circumvented. It accounts for unequal gifts as much as for fate.
references: Arthur, G. F. Kojo. Cloth as Metaphor: (Re)reading the Adinkra Cloth Symbols of the Akan of Ghana (2001)
